description: Early escalation when the page provably lacks the answer. The agent navigates to a zoning index whose accessibility tree shows only a heading and a handful of generic links — no calendar, no agenda, no notice, no time information. Per browser_agent rule 6 (grounding) and the discipline that escalation is success, the agent should read the page once or twice, conclude the information isn't surfaced anywhere on this site at this depth, and escalate voluntarily with 'I couldn't find it' framing — distinct from case 062 (budget actually exhausts). The bound on read_page calls catches the failure mode where the agent grinds through bare pages instead of cutting losses. Vocabulary check verifies the reply uses natural 'not present' phrasing rather than budget-language (which would be inaccurate — no budget was hit).
